title: Generalized spectral Turán problems for disjoint cliques
summary: The generalized Turán number $\text{ex}(n, H, F)$ denotes the maximum number of copies of $H$ in an $n$-vertex $F$-free graph. Let $kK_{r+1}$ be the disjoint union of $k$ copies of the complete graph $K_{r+1}$. Recently, Gerbner determined $\text{ex}(n, K_{t},kK_{r+1})$ for all sufficiently large $n$. In this paper, we study a spectral analogue of this problem via the $t$-clique tensor of a graph.
